narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>One hundred and thirty five divided by fifteen is nine, so nine kilograms each.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Fifteen students with nine kilograms each would need more than a hundred kilograms.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The point was lost on the way.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 9 kg each; fifteen bowls of 9 kg tower over the sack; the bubble is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>When the Ones cannot be shared, write zero Ones and the point.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then share the Tenths, and check by multiplying back.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the words zero Ones, then share the Tenths appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip ignores the point and writes nine kilograms each. Fifteen students would then need far more flour than there is.
